exclusions.why: Governance-of-record failures. The share of the uk-gdpr lower-tier exposure that ico's published control weights put on the system security plan (pl-2) and the risk assessment (ra-3) is retained by the insured: this cover attaches to breach consequence, not to the insured's own documentation of its programme.

conditions.why: Least privilege enforced on the governed namespace. This estate implements ac-6; cover is written on the assumption it stays implemented.
Configuration settings enforced. A lapse is survivable but re-rates the account by the stated amount at the next re-quote.
